To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. The address bus leakage is a serious security threat to XOM-based secure processors.2. A practical solution for protecting information leakage from address bus is presented.3. The solution is implemented in a real hardware platform and its performance overhead is negligible.

(i) the address bus leakage problem is very serious and can lead to serious security breaches, (ii) the problem is very hard to solve due to performance constraints, (iii) we propose an efficient infrastructure called HIDE to address this problem, and (iv) our experiments show that our solution is effective in practice.

(i) XOM is severely crippled without address bus protection; (ii) the problem of address-bus leakage is extremely difficult to solve in general; (iii) the HIDE infrastructure can provide an adequate level of security guarantees for data and code without performance penalty; and (iv) our solution provides the first practical solution to the problem of information exposure through the address bus
